question: \(AD\) is the median to side \(BC\) in \(\triangle ABC\). Given \(BC=10\text{ cm}\), find the length of \(BD\) (unit: cm).
solution: A median divides the opposite side into two equal segments, so \(BD=BC\div2=5\).
